## Classes

### AppStorageError

Thrown by the storage client when a read, write, reset, or watch is rejected by
the host; `code` identifies why.

#### Extends

- `Error`

### AppStorageWatch

```ts
type AppStorageWatch = ReadonlyStore<ResolvedAppStorage> & Disposable & object;
```

A live subscription to one storage key's resolved value: read the current value,
subscribe to changes, and close when done watching.

#### Type Declaration

| Name      | Type         | Description                                                  |
| --------- | ------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| `close()` | () => `void` | Stop watching and release the underlying event subscription. |

### AppStorageEventHandle

```ts
type AppStorageEventHandle = Disposable & object;
```

A live object capability backing one key's change-event stream, adapted to Fetch
so it can drive an `EventSource`.

#### Type Declaration

| Name      | Type                                   | Description                                                     |
| --------- | -------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `fetch()` | (`request`) => `Promise`\<`Response`\> | Forward one `EventSource` request to the host's event stream.   |
| `close()` | () => `Promise`\<`void`\>              | Release the change-event stream's underlying object capability. |

## Variables

### appStorageErrorCodes

```ts
const appStorageErrorCodes: readonly [
  "invalid",
  "undeclared_key",
  "scope_not_declared",
  "owner_required",
  "too_large",
  "quota_exceeded",
  "conflict",
  "unavailable",
];
```

Storage error codes the host and client agree on: invalid input, an undeclared
key, a scope this App never declared, a member-only action tried without a
member, a value or quota that is too large, a write conflict, or a transient
host failure.

  member: NullOr<
